checks: Scalar/channel gate gradients: changed two-row inputs, nonzero feature corrections, batch reduction and finite differences
Actual zero gate: identity Jacobian, zero first branch gradient, nonzero gate step, nonzero next branch gradients
Fixed/trainable scale: saved-state, buffer/parameter and optimizer-update contracts
Falsification: broadcastable width-one correction is rejected by canonical forward
Matched construction and diagnostics: same-seed prefix/stem/head, no parameter gradient accumulation or state mutation
scope: Complementary exact/native checks only; no 39-fit rerun, browser or pretrained training.
